claim: For a calculated health check, Route 53 adds up the number of child health checks that are considered healthy and compares that number with the number of child health checks that must be healthy for the parent health check to be considered healthy.

evidence.quote: Route 53 compares that number with the number of child health checks that must be healthy for the status of the parent health check to be considered healthy.
Route 53 adds up the number of child health checks that are considered to be healthy.
